## Zscaler, Inc. (ZS) `[Software & SaaS]`
- Citi analyst Fatima Boolani maintained a **Buy** rating and raised the price target to **$260 from $245**, citing an improving chief investment officer survey, stronger cybersecurity spending trends, and AI deployment driving security investment (Markets Insider, Oct. 15 06:00 ET).[3]
- Citi also raised targets on CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks while maintaining Buy ratings; channel-partner discussions and a reseller survey indicated improving cybersecurity spending into 2027 (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 14:02 ET).[8]
- A Pomerantz investigation into potential securities-law violations involving Zscaler and company officers was announced; the notice referenced Zscaler’s May 26 guidance of **$875 million–$878 million** for the current quarter versus a **$879 million** consensus and the Sept. 24 departure of Chief Revenue Officer Mike Rich (PR Newswire, Oct. 15 10:00 ET).[1]
- A secondary report stated that Zscaler reaffirmed fiscal 2027 revenue guidance and upcoming-quarter outlook; it also cited **$100 million** in AI-security bookings and **25%** annual recurring-revenue growth (Simply Wall St, Oct. 15; publication time not reported).[6][9]
- The company’s previously reported quarter was cited at **$898.19 million revenue** versus **$876.96 million consensus** and **$1.19 adjusted EPS** versus **$1.09 consensus**; the cited report did not identify a new earnings release within this window (MarketBeat, Oct. 15; publication time not reported).[4]

## Rubrik, Inc. (RBRK) `[Software & SaaS]`
- Curated Wealth Partners acquired **10,069 shares**, valued at approximately **$1.153 million**, during the third quarter; the report said RBRK traded at **$115.94** during Thursday’s session (The Stock Observer, Oct. 15; publication time not reported).[2]
- Rubrik expanded **Project Hourglass** with AHEAD, Trace3, and World Wide Technology and introduced **Rubrik Code Guardian** for AI-driven, air-gapped code-security testing (Simply Wall St, Oct. 16; publication time not reported).[10]
- The latest cited quarterly results were **$427.26 million revenue** versus **$396.30 million consensus** and **$0.20 EPS** versus **$0.04 consensus**; the report said revenue increased **43.9% year over year**, but these results were released Aug. 27 and were outside the requested window (Transcript Daily, Oct. 15; publication time not reported).[7]
